figurative_meaning_en: according to rule; properly; sufficiently; remarkably
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দস্তুর মতো কাজটি সম্পন্ন করেছে।
এখানে দস্তুর মতো সবকিছু ঠিকঠাক চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: He completed the task properly as per custom.
Everything runs sufficiently well here in the usual way.
note: Refers to adherence to established customs or norms in Bengali society
